choices.content: Data set B is more consistent
Data set A is more consistent
The two data sets have the same consistency

question.prompt: Data set A has a variance of 2. Data set B is obtained by adding 5 to every value in data set A. Comparing the two data sets, ( )

solutions.explanation: Adding 5 to every value also increases the mean by 5. Each value's difference from the mean remains unchanged, so the variance remains unchanged and the consistency is the same.
solutions.title: Track deviations from the mean
